newsitem.title: EGYPT: Palestinian President Arafat arrives in Cairo.
newsitem.headline: Palestinian President Arafat arrives in Cairo.

text.p: Palestinian President Yasser Arafat arrived in Cairo on Sunday for talks expected to include ways to break a deadlock in the Israeli-Palestinian peace process.
Airport sources reported Arafat's arrival but he did not speak to reporters.
Arafat was due to meet Foreign Minister Amr Moussa on Sunday and hold talks with President Hosni Mubarak on Monday.

The Palestinian leader said in Gaza on Sunday that the peace process in the Middle East was "completely frozen." Arafat frequently consults with Mubarak on ways to push forward peace talks with Israel, which stalled over Israel's breaking ground in March on a Jewish settlement in East Jerusalem.
Arafat is due to meet Israeli President Ezer Weizman at Erez border point in Gaza on Tuesday. U.S. Middle East envoy Dennis Ross is expected to return to the region on Monday.
